svg.title: Power plant operator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as power plant operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A side-view turbine casing has a visible circular rotor at its front beside a separate long control lever. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
